name: Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation
summary: Jiangsu High Hope International Group Corporation engages in the supply chain businesses in China and internationally. The company engages in trade, real estate, investment, logistics, manufacturing, services, etc. It is involved in the cold-chain logistics business that integrates warehousing, logistics, processing, display, trade, and other functions; healthcare supply chain business; recycling and sale of waste paper and scrap steel; waste sorting-related businesses; and import and export of home textiles, knitted clothing, woven clothing products, wood building materials, hardware and minerals, paper pulp, textiles and clothing, medicine, minerals, fresh food, and electromechanical equip…
